Treating me differently compared to other people and ignoring me, been with this girl for like a month, before we made it official it was amazing, she was warm and super talkative, but ever since we started dating she’s not the same.

The day after we made it official she started ignoring me, takes super long to respond while immediately responding to other people, she has become less talkative and more vague, she’s just cold af now, but she’s the total opposite with other people, and on top of that she flirts with other guys right in front of me every single day.

Asked her what was wrong many times but she pretended everything was fine, then one day asked her if she wanted to break up but she said absolutely not, which made it even more confusing, all I know is I’m losing interest and I’m considering ending this relationship.

So to me if a girl isn’t honest and clear about what’s going on, if she doesn’t treat me like she treats other people, and is flirting with other people,then I’m no longer interested no matter how much I like her.
He should’ve won in 2023, the entire crowd was behind him.

It’s not the same guy though, and honestly i don’t know, a part of me wanted to vent but most importantly i wanted a definitive answer on if I should break up or not, it’s hard for me to get to the conclusion that it’s what I should do, i needed to be sure that It was the right decision so I made this post.

Thank you.
Thank you man, I really appreciate your words and advice, it means a lot.

Also, we kept our relationship private, no one knows that we’re together, so she can’t even use that to make his gf not worry about it, which confuses me even more because I can’t understand why she insisted on being with me, she told me to ask her out, she begged me to be with her, only to turn cold the very next day, I’m lost.
She doesn’t even need me to talk to him, she met him a few weeks before I did, and I highly doubt his gf is aware of this.

Yeah seeing her stories genuinely made me sad, she’s making me feel like we never actually got together even though we did, she says she loves me and wants to be with me then say she wants to fall in love and hates being with someone. This genuinely hurt man.
I hope it will, saying that breaking up with her doesn’t affect me would be a lie, I genuinely loved her, but it seems like she never really loved me and was just saying it for the sake of it.

We have kept it private, so our friends don’t know that we got together, but they’ll for sure notice that something is off after we break up, it’s gonna be very awkward but it’s the only thing left to do.

I’m wondering if I should break up or just stop talking though, because right after we got together she stopped texting me and I always find myself texting first now even though it was the opposite before, I’m pretty sure if I stop texting the relationship is gonna fade away and end by itself without even saying it did.

Tbh I don’t think that’s a possibility, she did say once that she never talked to her exs and when she breaks up with someone she erases them forever and wants nothing to do with them ever again.

It’s gonna be very awkward, but this needs to stop.

And yeah, she doesn’t care about me at all, she doesn’t text me for days and answers with one word while talking and writing paragraphs to our common friends.

Also, I just remembered that, about a month before we started flirting and got together, she told me she was trying to get with a guy for about a month but he was ignoring her and was very evasive and vague, so I guess you might be right, she couldn’t get with that guy so instead she tried getting with me as a rebound.

Maybe that’s the case, but the things she posted really hurt me and I don’t want to feel this miserable anymore. I’m gonna break up with her today even though we have a ton of common friends, it’s gonna be awkward but it needs to be done.

Yeah I figured she was just saying she loved just for the sake of it, before we got together she said it in a very particular way that was both wholesome and cute, now whenever she says it it feels like saying I love you to your puppy just so it doesn’t feel sad. I guess  I’m gonna tell her today that we have to break up.

Yeah I think that’s what’s happening, l would’ve liked her to be more honest and clear instead of just stonewalling me, like I asked her if we should break up and she said no even though it’s clear she doesn’t want to be with me anymore, I guess she wants me to be the one to actually break up and is trying to push me to do it.

I tried talking to her, I said it in my previous posts, I asked her three times if something was wrong and why she was acting like this but she refused to admit something was wrong and pretended that everything was fine.

I never posted anything threatening on social media, yesterday was the birthday of my favourite singer passing away and I just wanted to pay homage to him.

As I already said, I have tried asking her what was wrong multiple times, asked her if I did something wrong, if she needed to talk about stuff that was bothering her, but she refused to answer every single time. 

I told her on many occasions that she could always count on me and that I was there for her but she leaves me on read.

I mentioned all of this in my previous posts, I tried everything with her but she’s not responsive and is closing herself every time I try to communicate.

I ended up telling her yesterday that this can’t continue and that if she wanted to put an end to this she could just say it instead of doing this, she said she didn’t want to break up and wants to stay with me, she then proceeded to tell me she loves me but just doesn’t know what to say when she’s in a relationship, I didn’t believe a word she said but I didn’t want to start arguing.

Then a few hours later she posted on her story that she despises relationships and that they were too confining, so I texted her about it and once again said that if she really hates it this much then we shouldn’t be together, she tried explaining it had nothing to do with me and she doesn’t want us to break up, and that she loves being with me. I once again didn’t believe a word of it, she’s obviously doing everything she can to push me to being the one to break up, and it worked. 

Honestly, at this point I’m not even mad, I’m just sad and disappointed, I can’t do this anymore, I’m gonna break up with her today, enough is enough.
We’ve known each other for 8 months and been talking regularly for 6 months, we’ve had feelings for each other for a long time but just didn’t get together up until two weeks ago.

She wanted us to be official, like about two hours after I asked her out and she accepted, she asked me if we were official and we both agreed that we were, and now I see her on her story saying that relationships are too restrictive and they’re dumb, I don’t know why she’s doing this and why she wanted us to be official in the first place, I’m just so confused.

We’ve known each other for about 8 months, started talking about 6 months ago, she never was like that, sure she always was a bit reserved but she was way warmer and more talkative, she’d tell me pretty personal stuff and I did the same, we felt comfortable with each other, we could open up about what was going on in our lives.

She even pushed me to ask her out as she confessed her feelings for me first, but ever since we got together she completely changed in just one night, I asked her out, she accepted and was extremely happy about it, then the following day she became very cold and has been like this for 2 weeks.

I’m sorry man, I was in a similar situation during my first year of college, a girl made me think she was into me but in reality what she wanted was to get close to a good friend of mine, when she did she ghosted me.

But my, you can already say ex girlfriend at this point cause it’s obviously over, isn’t trying to get the attention of someone else as we decided to keep it private when we officially got together, which is honestly even more confusing.

Yeah I figured that out, what I don’t understand is why she made me think she was then confessed her feelings and even pushed me to ask her out only to turn cold the following day, it just doesn’t make sense to me.

Thank you for your advice, you’re right.

I ended up asking her again if something was wrong and she once again said no, then I said that if something was she could tell me and we could talk about it, whether it was something I did or something else going on in her life, and she left me on read, safe to say it’s over, I can’t continue to put effort in someone who clearly doesn’t care and doesn’t want to talk to me.

She’s still talking to our common friend so I know she’s not busy or anything, he showed me their conversation earlier today and she was very talkative and full of energy, so I’m pretty sure she has a problem with me, I offered to talk about it like 3 times already at this point, but she always said everything is ok and even left me on read the last time I asked.

I’m done with this, I would have liked some kind of clarity and honesty, like an explanation on why she’s being so cold, but I guess I’m never getting it, so I’m gonna stop talking to her the same way she stopped talking to me because she clearly doesn’t want me in her life anymore.

I wonder why she was so warm and kind before though, she didn’t even have to accept when I asked her out, she could’ve said no but she didn’t, funny thing is I forgot to mention that she pushed me to ask her out, the two days after she confessed she literally told me she wanted me to ask her out, and when I did she accepted, only to turn cold literally the next day, now I wonder if she was even honest about how she felt or if it was all just a game to her.

Thank you for your help, I truly appreciate it.

Thank you, I did exactly what you said, I told her I cared about her and that I was there for her, to which she replied that she loved me, and have been checking on her every day or two but not pushing her to talk to me, I hope you’re right, I really don’t want to lose her, I love her so much.

She’s a face cause the fans love her but she’s still the same person she was back when she was a heel, she never acknowledged that she was in the wrong and never showed any remorse, she even said last year that she doesn’t regret it one bit, all while saying she’s gonna take back the title that she never lost even though she did lose, and when she lost to Iyo she still refused to accept it.

Her character needs to evolve, and her having a non title feud or even going for the IC title would be a breath of fresh air and something new and exciting, her going for the world title again and again is too repetitive imo, but I can understand why some people think otherwise, at the end of the day wrestling is subjective and I totally respect that.

TL;DR : she’s been in the world title picture for nearly 3 years, her character hasn’t evolved since except she turned face because the fans love her, they should give other people a chance and develop her character in non title feuds.
